The empty messages are clear and reassuring, and the failed-save behavior is right. An unreachable page should still be saveable with details I enter myself.

For long content, I’d allow titles up to two lines before shortening them; one line may hide the part that distinguishes similar links. Two lines for descriptions is fine. Very long notes should show a short preview with a **Show full note** control—viewing the full note shouldn’t require entering Edit, but it also shouldn’t overwhelm the list.

For a large library, I prefer **Load more** in manageable batches over numbered pages. Search, tag filters, and counts must still cover the entire matching collection, not only what has currently loaded. This is also where I’d need sorting, at least by newest added, oldest added, and title.

Relative times are useful for recent saves. After about a week, switch to an actual date including the year when relevant.

Please carry those choices into the proposed build.
